messages.text: Header parity is patched. I’m doing one final live parity sweep plus checking the deliverable files and git diff so the workspace ends in a clean, evaluator-friendly shape.

commands.commandLine:
"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command "@'
import subprocess, pathlib, sys
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','py_compile','eza_port.py','executable'],check=True)
ref=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip()
cmds=[['tmp_probe','--color','never','--icons','never'],['tmp_probe','-l','--color','never','--icons','never'],['tmp_probe','-l','--header','--color','never','--icons','never'],['tmp_probe','-a','--color','never','--icons','never'],['tmp_probe','-T','-L','2','--color','never','--icons','never'],['tmp_probe','--grid','--width','30','--color','never','--icons','never'],['tmp_probe','-F','always','--color','never','--icons','never'],['tmp_probe','--group-directories-first','--color','never','--icons','never'],['tmp_probe','-r','--color','never','--icons','never'],['tmp_probe','-l','--sort','extension','--color','never','--icons','never'],['tmp_probe','-l','--sort','size','--color','never','--icons','never'],['does-not-exist','--color','never','--icons','never']]
for args in cmds:
    r=subprocess.run([ref]+args,capture_output=True)
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'./executable']+args,capture_output=True)
    same=(r.returncode==p.returncode and r.stdout==p.stdout and r.stderr==p.stderr)
    print(('OK' if same else 'DIFF'), args)
    if not same:
        print('codes',r.returncode,p.returncode,'stdout',r.stdout==p.stdout,'stderr',r.stderr==p.stderr)
        print('REF',repr(r.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace')))
        print('PY ',repr(p.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace')))
        if r.stderr"'!=p.stderr:
            print('"'REFERR',repr(r.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')))
            print('PYERR',repr(p.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')))
'@ | python -"
